bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
wt="$(pwd -P)/.worktrees/notice-live-20261127"
branch=fix/notice-live-adopted-20261127
notice=ce50d5e1b755b374b7527d895e2fd7246f565cfc
live=fac6bfd5b1ec38809368d3a3097001d0080eace7
base=7b24187988d1ec3f38afead7786fed018b8eb42a
test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$notice"
test -z "$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = bf3ace0a37071c32d08a1478994cc969eff2578b28383c529b4cd57b1288034a
git -C "$wt" fetch origin "refs/heads/$branch"
test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$notice"
git -C "$wt" fetch origin refs/heads/fix/profile-public-deployed-bundle-20261121
git -C "$wt" merge-base --is-ancestor "$live" FETCH_HEAD
git -C "$wt" merge-base --is-ancestor "$base" "$live"
git -C "$wt" merge-base --is-ancestor "$base" "$notice"
cd "$wt"
cleanup(){ if git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null; then git merge --abort; fi; }
trap cleanup EXIT
if ! git merge --no-commit --no-ff "$live"; then
 git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
 exit 61
fi
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
expected={"artifacts/bot/"+p for p in "src/bot/noticeInteractions.ts src/bot/postingHandlers.ts src/db/migrate.ts src/gaybbsBot.ts src/services/announcementApplications.ts src/services/announcementNotifications.ts src/services/noticeEditor.ts src/services/publicPostRepository.ts src/services/publishService.ts src/services/telegramDispatcher.ts tests/announcementNotifications.test.ts tests/gaybbsMigrationIntegration.ts tests/noticeEditor.test.ts".split()}
actual=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--cached","--name-only","fac6bfd5b1ec38809368d3a3097001d0080eace7"],text=True).splitlines())
print("NOTICE_SOURCE_DELTA",sorted(actual))
if actual!=expected:raise SystemExit("NOTICE_SOURCE_SCOPE_MISMATCH")
PY
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m "fix(notice): integrate currently deployed profile and DM baseline without reverting other features"
new="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$notice" "$new"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$live" "$new"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch"
test "$(git ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$branch" | cut -f1)" = "$new"
echo NOTICE_INTEGRATED_SOURCE_SHA="$new"
echo NOTICE_SOURCE_SCOPE=PASS
